basis: Dec 2025 large-load interconnection queue volume; ~70-77% from data centres; up from ~63 GW at end-2024; ERCOT states most 'will not materialize'
source: ERCOT System Planning and Weatherization Update, Dec 2025 (via Belfer Center); Utility Dive cites ~233 GW at the 9 Dec 2025 ERCOT board meeting
methodology_trace: Raw unvetted large-load request tracking across the ERCOT interconnection queue prior to the PGRR115 and NPRR1234 market gate implementation. Represents a maximally padded queue due to near-zero historical barrier to entry and lack of upfront deposit requirements.
data_governance_notes: Public operator tracking cited in secondary regulatory analysis and board reports; unvetted submission volume without contractual commitments.

basis: ERCOT-commissioned resource-adequacy scenario modelling; represents ~10x today's operational data-centre load
source: Aurora Energy Research Resource Adequacy study for ERCOT (via Utility Dive)
methodology_trace: Independent resource adequacy forward scenario modelling commissioned by ERCOT estimating deliverable operational large-load capacity under transmission, generation buildout, and lead-time constraints; a commissioned scenario model, not an empirical measurement.
data_governance_notes: Commissioned consulting study for ERCOT board planning; scenario projection rather than realized measurement.

basis: large loads approved-and-observed-energized since 2022, as of 18 Nov 2025 = 5,302 MW (~2% of ERCOT large-load tracking); timing-limited, NOT a completion rate
source: ERCOT Large Load Interconnection Process Q&A, 24 Dec 2025
methodology_trace: Observed operational energisation tracking reflecting early buildout timing, site preparation, substation construction, and multi-year lead times rather than eventual terminal project attrition. Represents an age artefact of an early-stage cohort.
data_governance_notes: Official ERCOT Q&A disclosure; primary operator snapshot of operational status across the ERCOT footprint.
